items.label: Generate Report Now
items.description: Generate and post a current health report snapshot immediately

reportFrequency.label: Report Frequency
reportFrequency.helpText: How often should the health report be generated? Hourly/4-hourly/12-hourly fire at the configured Report Minute. Daily/Weekly fire at the configured Report Hour. Custom uses a cron expression.

reportHour.label: Report Hour
reportHour.helpText: Hour of day (0-23) in the selected timezone when daily/weekly reports fire. Default: 12 (noon). Use the Timezone setting to set your local offset.

reportMinute.label: Report Minute
reportMinute.helpText: Minute of hour (0-59) when hourly/4-hourly/12-hourly reports fire. Default 0 (top of the hour). For daily/weekly, minute 0 is used by default.

customCron.label: Custom Cron Expression
customCron.helpText: 5-field cron expression (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week). Examples: '0 */2 * * *' = every 2 hours, '30 9 * * 1-5' = weekdays at 9:30. Only minute and hour fields are used for report timing. Tips: 0 * * * * = hourly, 0 12 * * * = daily noon, 0 12 * * 1 = weekly Monday noon. See crontab.guru for help.

timezoneOffset.label: Timezone
timezoneOffset.helpText: Select your timezone offset from UTC. Auto-detect: check your current UTC offset at https://time.is/UTC.

showPosts.label: Show Post Count
showPosts.helpText: Include post submission count in the report.

showComments.label: Show Comment Count
showComments.helpText: Include comment submission count in the report.

showRemovals.label: Show Removal Count
showRemovals.helpText: Include content removal count in the report.

showApprovals.label: Show Approval Count
showApprovals.helpText: Include content approval count in the report.

showRuleViolations.label: Show Rule Violations
showRuleViolations.helpText: Include the top violated rules section in the report.

showTopOffenders.label: Show Repeat Offenders
showTopOffenders.helpText: Include the repeat offenders section in the report.

showModActivity.label: Show Mod Activity
showModActivity.helpText: Include the moderator activity section in the report.

showKarmaStats.label: Show Karma Stats
showKarmaStats.helpText: Include karma statistics (account age, link/comment karma) for repeat offenders.

showLeaderboard.label: Show Mod Leaderboard
showLeaderboard.helpText: Show ranked leaderboard of top moderators by action count with workload percentages.

showInactiveAlerts.label: Show Inactive Mod Alerts
showInactiveAlerts.helpText: Flag moderators who have been inactive beyond the threshold.

inactiveThresholdDays.label: Inactive Threshold (Days)
inactiveThresholdDays.helpText: Number of days without action before a moderator is flagged as inactive. Default: 5.

showAnomalyAlerts.label: Show Anomaly Alerts
showAnomalyAlerts.helpText: Flag unusual activity spikes (2x above 7-day rolling average) in the report header. Detects potential brigading or spam waves.

showDebugInfo.label: Debug Mode
showDebugInfo.helpText: Show current configuration and settings at the top of each report. Useful for debugging.
